reliable.label: Behind the integration
reliable.title: What makes an integration reliable
paragraphs: A reliable integration is more than connecting two systems. It means defining field mapping and data ownership, handling webhooks and API limits, and building in retries, reconciliation and monitoring so critical data keeps moving reliably across Shopify, ERP, POS and the rest of your infrastructure.

When an existing connector fits the process, we use it. When the business logic is more complex, we build the integration layer around it — based on the systems involved, data volume, operational risk and how the business actually works.
For one retailer, we send sold quantities to Xentral as individual stock movements instead of overwriting stock totals. Online orders keep their changes, and every adjustment can be traced.

architecture.label: System architecture
architecture.title: How your systems work together
paragraphs: Shopify, ERP and POS each have their own role. We build the integration layer between them so data moves reliably across the entire operation.

diagram.svgDesc: Shopify (commerce platform, with Shopify POS in store) connects to the middleware (integration layer) in both directions: products and barcodes one way, orders and sales the other. The middleware exchanges product data (XML) and weighed item barcodes with the Mettler Toledo scales, and sends sold quantities per store to the ERP (Xentral) every night.

case.label: Proven in practice
challenge: The retailer sells weighed goods across physical stores. Shopify had to become the single master system for products, barcodes and sales, including items sold by weight. The scales, the POS and the Xentral ERP each needed the same data, in their own format.
built: Middleware that generates barcodes for weighed and per-piece items and syncs products to Mettler Toledo scales. A Shopify POS extension that reads the scale’s barcode and adds the weighed item to the cart automatically. An admin panel for barcode rules with a full audit log. A nightly sync that sends sold weights per store and per SKU to Xentral as stock movements, without overwriting stock changed by online orders.

items.q: Who will we be talking to?
items.a: Alexander Karl, our DACH partner, is your contact in German. Our team builds and supports the system.

items.q: Can you connect Shopify to our ERP?
items.a: Yes. We have built integrations with Xentral, Odoo and custom ERPs. Other systems connect through their API, and where there is no usable API, we build the connector.

items.q: Can Shopify POS work with scales and weighed goods?
items.a: Yes. We connected Shopify POS to Mettler Toledo scales, so barcodes on weighed items are read at checkout and sold weights flow into the ERP.

items.q: How long does an integration take?
items.a: A single well-documented connection takes weeks. A multi-system build takes months, mostly in discovery. We scope it before quoting.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after launch?
items.a: We monitor the connections we build, alert on failures, and can take over maintenance when either side’s API changes.

items.q: Does our store need Shopify Plus?
items.a: Not always. Plus matters for high API volume or custom checkout logic. We tell you during scoping.
